# Guaso Content SDK (@guaso-ai/content)

Server-only (npm `server-only` poison + runtime assert). Env: GUASO_SITE_ID, GUASO_CONTENT_TOKEN. Optional GUASO_API_BASE (default https://api.guaso.link). ⛔ NEXT_PUBLIC_*. Optional ESLint `no-restricted-imports` — npm i does NOT configure ESLint.

```ts
import { createClient } from "@guaso-ai/content";
const c = createClient({ siteId: process.env.GUASO_SITE_ID!, token: process.env.GUASO_CONTENT_TOKEN! });
const e = await c.getEntry("pages/home"); // { data, empty }
const batch = await c.getEntries(["pages/home", "pages/about"]);
```

Empty-clear: missing key → `{ data: null, empty: true }` (HTTP 200).
Revalidate: register HTTPS webhook at create; Guaso POSTs `{ secret, tags, siteId?, guasoVersion? }`.
Blocks UI: install kit via shadcn registry `@guaso` (https://github.com/guaso-ai/guaso-blocks) — BlockZone + canonical block types. ⛔ hardcode sections / invent props outside content schema.
⛔ browser / client components. ⛔ write API. ⛔ Neon credentials.
